name: Content above the cap asks for a level this realm can reach
contract: A realm whose characters stop at 60 maps authored content onto its own bands, so what that content asks of a character has to move with it. ProgressionLayout maps an authored level through the era its own level places it in: the Burning Crusade band 58-70 onto 45-55, the Wrath band 68-80 onto 55-60. Quest 9900 Gava'xi is authored at minimum level 65 and quest 12691 at 77, so a level 60 character may take both, and the minimum level their quest query carries is the mapped one rather than the authored one - a quest the server allows must not read as out of reach. The same mapping decides an ability rank's required level, which the Book of Ascension scenarios cover where they buy a rank authored above the cap.

steps.label: CONTROL: the character stands at the realm's cap
A quest authored at minimum level 65 can be taken at 60
Its quest query carries the mapped minimum level, 65 in the 58-70 band onto 45-55
A quest authored at minimum level 77 can be taken at 60
Its quest query carries the mapped minimum level, 77 in the 68-80 band onto 55-60
